decision: Every material mutation must belong to a wave with explicit ownership, acceptance criteria, evidence and handoff.
AGENTS.md is the execution authority; tool-specific instruction files are shims and may not fork policy.
GOAL.md remains stable while STATE.md and machine JSON are mutable frontier mirrors; ledgers/evidence preserve chronology.
context: Separate mission contracts from operational state.

decision: Acquire pinned upstreams as partial Git object stores with immutable local pin refs, then materialize only source/config through an explicit sparse projection.
context: OpenClaw/Omi are too large for indiscriminate worktree acquisition; CP01 needs complete provenance without downloading irrelevant binary/model/media assets.

decision: Graphify preserves raw source evidence and COSGraph adds non-destructive integration facets; neither raw symbol counts nor provisional COS groups constitute the CP01 capability denominator.
context: Prevent heuristic extraction from becoming destructive deduplication or false parity. W03/W04 own behavioral-surface promotion and canonicalization.

decision: Graph engineering uses four one-way planes: P0 SOURCE_EVIDENCE -> P1 SEMANTIC_SURFACE -> P2 COS20D_DECISION -> P3 AGENT_CONTEXT; higher planes never mutate lower evidence.
context: Separate primary provenance from semantic candidates, provisional architecture decisions and agent recovery context.

decision: COS-20L runtime responsibility and COS-20D change/integration analysis are orthogonal; 20D is projected onto components, decisions, waves and ContextPacks rather than every raw source node.
context: Preserve analytical depth without multiplying a million-node forensic graph into an unusable artifact.

decision: Integration promotion follows OBSERVED_SOURCE -> DISCOVERED_CANDIDATE -> BEHAVIOR_MAPPED -> CONTRACT_MAPPED -> TEST_MAPPED -> VERIFIED -> MIGRATION_ELIGIBLE; destructive convergence is forbidden before MIGRATION_ELIGIBLE.
context: Prevent CANONICALIZE/MERGE_STATE/REWRITE_LATER hypotheses from becoming premature migrations.

decision: The future-agent ContextPack is a deterministic derived recovery view generated from canonical state and ledgers; it is never an independent source of truth and drift must fail CI.
context: Eliminate dependence on chat history while preventing derived context from inventing project state.

decision: Evidence gates are bound to the exact candidate HEAD; cancelled, timed-out, superseded or partial workflow runs never close a wave and their cause must be recorded before rerun.
context: W02 demonstrated that acquisition success plus a cancelled structural compiler is not structural-inventory evidence.
CP01 release candidate passed all W03-W08 invariants and produced a non-empty behavior-mapped denominator.
decision: Close CP01 and enter CP02 from the exact-source full-compiler release candidate while preserving VERIFIED parity at zero and forbidding migration.
